title: fix(plugin-grid): object-grid's deprecated title resolves a locale map like label does (objectui#10993, batch 3)
body:
Part of #10993
Clause-②: no

Batch 3 of the `I18nLabel` family card. This PR resumes a run that a container restart killed after its first commit was pushed: that commit was re-read against the order, kept, and extended (see Deviations).

## What changed

`object-grid`'s deprecated `title` is the legacy spelling of `label`, read at two sites and only when `label` resolves to nothing: the data-table caption and the view label that goes into the export file name. `@objectstack/spec` types `title` as `I18nLabel` and its validator accepts an inline locale map, but both sites handed `title` on raw. Both now resolve it through the same `resolveInlineI18nLabel` against `useDisplayLocale()` that `label` uses. `label` is still tried first; a plain-string `title` renders as authored.

Files: `ObjectGrid.tsx`, one new pin `ObjectGrid.titleI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx`, one changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`: patch). No registry input, type, export or accepted set moves: `title` stays one of the block's unregistered deprecated spellings, so no manifest row and no parity-test edit.

## Measured on the base (red first)

The pin mounts `{ type: 'object-grid', properties: { objectName, title: map } }` through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the registered block, with the `en` entry first so a first-entry fallback fails the zh row. Seven rows: caption zh, caption en, plain-string control, `label` still wins when both are authored, an empty `label` falls through to the `title` map, the export file name under zh, and a plain-string export control.

| leg | result | what it shows |
|:--|:--|:--|
| both sites at the base blob of `ObjectGrid.tsx` | 4 failed, 3 passed | each red row paints `Component "data-table" failed to render` with "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})"; the three controls stay green |
| export site alone reverted to the raw `title` | 1 failed, 6 passed | the export row reads `contacts-[object Object]-DATE-TIME.csv`; the caption rows stay green |
| caption site alone reverted | 4 failed, 3 passed | same reds as the base: the block fails before its export menu exists |
| head | 7 passed (10 with the `label` twin beside it) | |

So the export row pins the second site on its own, and the changeset's `[object Object]` sentence is a measurement, not an inference. The mutations went through `ablation-replace` (anchor hit once, blob changed, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`) and the whole-file base leg through a hash-checked script with a trap restore. The pin imports the package's own source through a relative path, so no `dist` sits between the mutation and the run.

## Amendment from the seat: a flaky pin in plugin-dashboard

Batch 2's `ObjectMetric.i18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` failed once in a merge group (`Test (shard 5/8)`, for a docs-only PR) with "Found multiple elements with the role heading". Its `drawerHeading()` read `within(dialog).getByRole('heading')`. Once the drill-down query settles, the body's empty state draws its own heading beside the drawer title, so the helper raced the data source.

- Reproduced with no timing sleep: let the body settle before reading. The old query is red on all four rows that read the heading (4 failed, 2 passed), and the matches are the drawer title `h2` and the empty-state `h3`.
- Fix: the helper is now `drawerNamed(name)`, which finds the dialog by its accessible name. The drawer sets `aria-labelledby` from its own title, so the helper cannot see the body and states "the panel is headed by X" directly.
- Same probe with the fixed helper and the body settled: 6 passed. The committed pin: 6 passed. Pointing the title resolution at the wrong locale (`pickLocalized(title, 'en')`, restored and proven) turns the zh title row red, so the pin still bites.
- The same unscoped shape elsewhere: every test that names objectui#10993 was searched for a heading query with no name or level. This was the only hit.
- Test-only; the changeset presence check accepts it beside the one changeset above (it compared 2 released packages and the declared changeset satisfied it).

## Gates (at head ac8ff01c0)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/`: 168 files, 1560 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`: 152 files, 1385 passed, 6 skipped.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: exit 0 after building each dependency closure (turbo, upstream direction: the packages they import). Both run `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFiles` shows the second reads `ObjectGrid.tsx` and both grid pins in plugin-grid, and the object-metric pin in plugin-dashboard.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the changed `.ts` and `.tsx` files: 0 errors. The three test files are clean; `ObjectGrid.tsx` carries its existing warnings and this diff adds no `any`.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations, report-only), `changeset:check` (fixed group and no-major), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:shell-escape-residue`: all exit 0.
- `check:changeset-claims` lists five pending changesets that name `ObjectGrid.tsx`. Their paragraphs were read: none describes the caption or export title reads, so none went false.
- NOT MEASURED: the full CI farm (CI's), and a browser render (the pin drives the real `SchemaRenderer` and registered block in the test DOM).

## Acceptance notes (not filed, not fixed here)

- The `columnDiagnosticLabel` read (`schema.label ?? schema.title`) in `ObjectGrid.tsx` is a raw `title` read too, but it only feeds a console diagnostic and the address builder keeps a value only when it is a string. A map there drops the hint and prints nothing wrong, so it is left as is.
- The record-detail overlay heading reads `label` only, never `title`; nothing to repair there.
- `ObjectGridSchema.title` in `packages/types` is still typed `string`, narrower than the spec's `I18nLabel`. That is the TS face, which batch 4 carries serially behind the `@objectstack` lockfile bump; this PR does not touch `packages/types` or the parity test.

## Deviations

1. Resumed run: a previous dev run on this order was killed by a container restart after pushing `e81da1781`. Its diff was judged against the order and kept; new commits sit on top, no force-push.
2. One file outside the claim's surface: a two-line header comment in `ObjectGrid.labelI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` said the `title` fallback "still reads a map raw" and was held to a later batch. This change makes that sentence false, so it now points at the new pin.
3. The plugin-dashboard pin repair above joined the surface by the seat's amendment.
4. The harness's suggested commit and PR attribution lines name a model; `AGENTS.md` and the order require the model-free pair and the session-URL footer, so those are what these commits and this body carry.
